notes: Know Your Rights (Adult): gameId know-your-rights matches registry (export KnowYourRightsGame). Reworks ModesEngine build onto v2 engine. 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 51 JSON: 6 cats (rights-at-work/harassment-and-posh/renting-and-consumer/cyber-and-data/claim-it/tools-and-help), 7 types (branch 18/strike-rewrite 16/sort 13/reflect 12/match 10/role-play 8/spot 7), 0% binary. EDUCATIONAL NOT legal advice; all law content flagged for expert review/localisation/currency. India: POSH Act 2013 & ICs (10+ employees, 3-month window, interns covered), Consumer Protection Act 2019, DPDP, NALSA legal aid 15100, police/FIR Zero FIR; helplines 181/1091/112/1930/1098 (reassureCats harassment-and-posh+claim-it+cyber-and-data). binStyle: added exploitation/dead end/hinders->red (all g51-only, clearly bad-side; improved kr-042/057/063). Spot ids injected (7). Builds on g35; pairs g50; precedes c6.
